sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme" is an initiative by the Karnataka Minority Development Corporation (KMDC) to promote self-employment and economic activities among minority communities. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible individuals from minority communities.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Skills & Employment; Sector: Citizen empowerment

**Detailed Description:** The "Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka, and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme aims to promote self-employment and economic activities among minority communities and provides financial assistance to eligible individuals from minority communities to start or expand their economic activities, thereby fostering economic empowerment and self-sufficiency.
**Benefits / Assistance:** Financial Assistance provided totals ₹1,00,000/- in two parts: - 50% Loan Amount - 50% Subsidy Amount

**Application Process:** **Step-01:** Applicant need to visits the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation [official website](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/home). **Step-02:** Click "[Apply Online](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/login)&quot
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Minorities Welfare Department
